segments.speech: Good morning, Roosevelt! It's Friday morning, October 23rd, and we are 17 days away from your big exam on November 9th. Let's start fresh with a cup of coffee and dive into the Domain Name System, or DNS. Ready?

elements.text: What is the Domain Name System (DNS)?
Analogy: DNS is like the contacts app on your smartphone.

segments.speech: Think of the internet like a massive city where every house has an IP address number like 142.250.190.46. Humans are terrible at remembering long numbers, so DNS acts like your phone's contact list. It translates friendly names like google.com into numeric IP addresses. Does that make sense so far?
